summary: P6 records the mirror in all four decisions.md sections, and every factual claim checks out against HelmCharts, the provider, Ansible and ArgoCDDeploy. The one finding is advisory: the RGW bullet gives the admin key's readers as a complete list, but the Ansible policy comment names another reader.

findings.summary: decisions.md:91 says the admin key is not an app credential and lists its readers as complete, but openbao.yml:66-68 names artifact-upload pipelines as another reader; close-out Q1 calls the record silent on this
